content:
The highly anticipated Emmy Awards kick off this weekend with the Creative Arts categories revealing their winners first. The Primetime ceremony will be held on September 14, where top honours including Best Drama Series and Best Comedy Series will be handed out.

For now, Apple has every reason to celebrate — Apple TV+ has surged into the weekend with a record-breaking 20 awards. The vast majority of those came from the comedy *Widows Bay*, which swept up 8 awards and has emerged as the heavy favourite for Best Comedy Series.

As it stands, Apple leads the 2026 Emmys with 20 awards, HBO Max follows with 16, and Netflix has 13. Once the Primetime Emmys are all handed out, the latter two are expected to overtake Apple in the overall tally, though Apple can still comfortably hold a respectable third place.

Apple is expected to shine in the comedy categories, though it may be outshone in drama by competitors such as *The Pitt*. The answers will be revealed next Monday.

By the current count, *Widows Bay* has taken 8 awards, *Pluribus* 4, *Margo's Got Money Troubles* 3, *Palm Royale* 3, and the documentary *Mr Scorsese* 1.

Apple TV+ productions accounted for 19 of those awards; with the addition of Apple's advertisement *I'm Not Remarkable*, which took 1 award, the total comes to exactly 20:

*Widow’s Bay*

  • Best Guest Actress in a Comedy Series: Betty Gilpin
  • Best Production Design for a Half-Hour Narrative Program
  • Best Casting for a Comedy Series
  • Best Cinematography for a Series (Half-Hour)
  • Best Original Music for a Series (Original Dramatic Score)
  • Best Music Supervision
  • Best Sound Editing for a Comedy or Drama Series (Half-Hour) or Animation
  • Best Sound Mixing for a Comedy or Drama Series (Half-Hour) or Animation

*Pluribus*

  • Best Production Design for a Contemporary Narrative Program (One Hour or More Per Episode)
  • Best Editing for a Drama Series
  • Best Original Main Title Theme Music
  • Best Sound Mixing for a Comedy or Drama Series (One Hour Per Episode)

*Margo's Got Money Troubles*

  • Best Contemporary Costumes for a Series
  • Best Contemporary Hairstyling
  • Best Contemporary Makeup (Non-Prosthetic)

*Palm Royale*

  • Best Choreography for a Scripted Program
  • Best Period or Fantasy/Sci-Fi Costumes
  • Best Period or Fantasy/Sci-Fi Makeup (Non-Prosthetic)

*Mr. Scorsese*

  • Best Documentary or Nonfiction Series

Apple TV+ began the season with a record-breaking 89 Emmy nominations; by the time the Primetime Emmy Awards roll around on September 14, we will see just how many more of those nominations translate into wins. The numbers once again reflect the high regard in which industry critics hold the overall quality of Apple's programming.
